ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white) linear and circular pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) distributed across the dark field of both lobes; localized clusters of small white circular points concentrated primarily on the mid-to-outer regions of both fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp convergence point at the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with low-amplitude pixel variations (jaggedness) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature near the median notch transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, discrete white circular clusters scattered across the ventral surface, with a higher frequency on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of overlapping, multi-directional white linear scratches (rake marks) of varying lengths across the central dark pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring patterns consistent with parallel-line rake marks across the majority of the visible fluke area.
